name: Workspace name
typesHint: Select the templates you want available in this workspace. You can choose several, or start with your own custom templates.
typesLater: Change your selection later in Preferences → Modules → Lab-book types. Projects and lab books are always available.
encryptionHint: Records, drafts, history and attachments are encrypted automatically.
deviceHint: Unlock through your operating-system account. Authorize more devices later.
passwordHint: Unlock on any device with your workspace password.
passwordLength: Use at least 12 characters. Add a recovery key in Storage & access after creating the workspace.
databaseUnavailable: PostgreSQL is unavailable. Check the database connection before creating the workspace.
